in_sanskrit.name: Aishiki
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Feelings, Emotions
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aishiki एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Aishiki is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Aish' which means 'feelings' or 'emotions'. This name is used to evoke a sense of deep connection and emotional intelligence. It is believed that those named Aishiki are naturally attuned to their own feelings and those of others, making them compassionate and wise.
